data.raw_text:
WATCH: Three sets of adaptive traffic signal lights are turned over by the NLEx Corporation to the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) on Tuesday, August 5.

MMDA Chair Don Artes says the traffic signal lights are installed along C3 Road, España Boulevard, and Ramon Magsaysay Boulevard.

“Nasa 143,000 po ang dumadaan dito sa may intersection na ito sa isang araw na mabebenepisyuhan ng isang smart-traffic signaling system,” Artes says during the ceremonial switching along Ramon Magsaysay Blvd. | @MJSalcedoINQ
